Retain existing Apache-2.0 copyright headers and years on edited files; do not alter license comments.

decisions.choice: Resolve conditional JSON Schema constructs (dependencies, if/then/else, allOf, and conditional oneOf/anyOf) against accumulated stepsState in Stepper/utils.ts and reuse across Stepper, createAsyncValidators, ReviewState, and findSchemaForKey.
rejected: Injecting earlier step properties into currentStep.schema.properties for RJSF to evaluate
Relying on raw JSONSchema Draft07 getSchema with unmodified formData
decisions.reason: Injecting earlier step properties into currentStep.schema.properties causes RJSF to re-render earlier steps' inputs in the active step, while raw JSONSchema Draft07 treats unset undefined properties as satisfying if: { properties: { flag: { const: true } } } when required is omitted.

decisions.topic: Unset boolean and optional property semantics in cross-step conditions
decisions.choice: When evaluating condition predicates, populate schema default values for undefined fields, treat unset boolean properties (undefined) as false for boolean const/not comparisons, and require positive property conditions (such as const or enum without not) to match a defined value.
rejected: Mutating stepsState to replace undefined with false on step submission
decisions.reason: Existing Stepper behavior and tests require untouched optional fields to remain present with undefined values in stepsState while preventing if: { properties: { flag: { const: true } } } from evaluating to true when flag is undefined.

decisions.topic: Pruning stale conditional values on back-navigation
decisions.choice: Compare all property keys defined across template steps (including conditional branches) against the active resolved property keys for the current stepsState, and omit keys that belong only to inactive conditional branches when advancing steps, rendering ReviewState, or calling onCreate.
rejected: Enabling RJSF omitExtraData and liveOmit on the per-step Form
decisions.reason: RJSF omitExtraData only sees the active step's schema and would strip values collected in earlier steps from the shared stepsState.

units.behaviour: Extracts uiSchema properties from step schemas and resolves conditional JSON Schema branches (dependencies, if/then/else, allOf, oneOf, anyOf) against accumulated formData.
rules: 1. In extractUiSchema, when items is an object, reuse uiSchema.items if it is already an object instead of overwriting it, then recurse into items.
2. Export type ResolveSchemaOptions = { earlierStepKeys?: Set<string>; booleanKeys?: Set<string> }.

3. Export function isConditionOnlyProperty(propKey: string, propSchema: JsonObject, options?: { depKey?: string; baseProperties?: JsonObject; earlierStepKeys?: Set<string> }): boolean that returns true when options?.depKey === propKey, or 'not' in propSchema, or 'const' in propSchema, or (!('type' in propSchema) && !('title' in propSchema) && !('ui:field' in propSchema) && !('ui:widget' in propSchema) && !('properties' in propSchema) && !('items' in propSchema)), or (Boolean(options?.earlierStepKeys?.has(propKey)) && !(options?.baseProperties && propKey in options.baseProperties) && 'enum' in propSchema && !('title' in propSchema)), and false otherwise.
4. Define helper hasDependencyValue(val: JsonValue | undefined): boolean returning val !== undefined && val !== null && val !== false && val !== '' && (!Array.isArray(val) || val.length > 0).

5. Define helper matchesPropertyCondition(propKey: string, propCond: JsonObject, data: JsonObject, booleanKeys: Set<string>): boolean that evaluates val = data[propKey] with isBooleanProp = booleanKeys.has(propKey) and effectiveVal = val === undefined && isBooleanProp ? false : val: handle propCond.not by negation (returning true if only 'not'/'type' keys exist and inner condition is false), propCond.allOf/anyOf/oneOf recursively, propCond.const via lodash isEqual(effectiveVal, propCond.const), propCond.enum via effectiveVal !== undefined && propCond.enum.some(item => isEqual(effectiveVal, item)), nested propCond.properties/required via isObject(effectiveVal) && matchesCondition(propCond, effectiveVal, booleanKeys), and any remaining JSON Schema keywords by returning val !== undefined && new JSONSchema({ type: 'object', properties: { [propKey]: propCond }, required: [propKey] }).validate({ [propKey]: effectiveVal }).length === 0.

6. Define helper matchesCondition(cond: JsonObject, data: JsonObject, booleanKeys: Set<string>): boolean that checks cond.not, cond.allOf, cond.anyOf, cond.oneOf, cond.required (every required key not in cond.properties must satisfy hasDependencyValue(data[reqKey])), and cond.properties (every object entry must satisfy matchesPropertyCondition).

7. Export function resolveConditionalSchema(schema: JsonObject, formData: JsonObject, options?: ResolveSchemaOptions): JsonObject that clones schema, populates effectiveData with defined values from formData plus default values from schema.properties when formData[k] === undefined, tracks booleanKeys for type === 'boolean' properties, and resolves allOf, if/then/else, dependencies (array required list when hasDependencyValue, or object dependency with oneOf/anyOf/allOf/if/properties), and conditional top-level oneOf/anyOf (where at least one branch has if or a property matching isConditionOnlyProperty).

8. When merging an active branch in resolveConditionalSchema, recursively resolve the branch first, merge non-condition properties (where !isConditionOnlyProperty) into resolvedProperties (updating effectiveData with branch property defaults when undefined and booleanKeys for boolean properties), add branch required keys to resolvedRequired only when reqKey !== depKey and (reqKey in resolvedProperties || !options?.earlierStepKeys?.has(reqKey)), delete resolved allOf/if/then/else/dependencies and conditional oneOf/anyOf keys, and recursively resolve nested object properties in resolvedProperties while leaving array items untouched.

9. Export function collectAllSchemaPropertyKeys(schema: JsonObject, earlierStepKeys?: Set<string>, depKey?: string): Set<string> that collects all non-condition property keys (where !isConditionOnlyProperty) across schema.properties, schema.then, schema.else, schema.allOf, schema.oneOf, schema.anyOf, and schema.dependencies.
